T:P1.7.text: The 2027 Shingle Color of the Year, Summer Harvest, captures the beauty of late summer as it gently transitions into autumn. T:P2.3.text: Our global nonwovens business is dedicated to transforming four key markets - construction, flooring, interiors, and industrial - with differentiated solutions that enable a world of possibilities for architects, builders, and designers.

T:P2.5.text: Compared to traditional ceiling materials, GLAS- POWERED™ ceiling facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a brighter, quieter office space or a mold conscious healthcare facility, each veil request is tailor-made to fit your needs.

T:P2.6.text: Glas-Powered Facers for Insulated Roof Decks & Walls

T:P2.7.text: Compared to traditional materials like paper faced insulation boards, Owens Corning GLAS- POWERED™ facers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a more durable exterior, to extend the life of your roof deck, or for a moisture resistant building envelope, Owens Corning Glass Coated Facers (GCF) for polyisocyanurate (polyiso) insulated roof decks & walls are tailor-made to fit your needs.

T:P2.8.text: Compared to traditional materials like paper faced gypsum board or OSB, Owens Corning GLAS- POWERED™ gypsum facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Designed to increase weatherability, mold & mildew resistance, impact resistance & dimensional stability.

C:P1.1.text: Full-Service Site Access & Project Solutions | NPK

C:P1.2.text: NPK is your trusted partner in site access solutions, offering sustainable composite matting and full-service support for projects across industries.

C:P1.4.text: At NPK, we tackle your challenges head-on. We are the only site access solutions partner to manufacture and rent industry-leading sustainable composite matting, along with a full suite of services including planning, logistics, and remediation – so you can protect your people, the environment, and your bottom line.

C:P1.5.text: Comprehensive Site Access Solutions You Can Trust

C:P1.6.text: You bring the vision – we bring the expertise.

C:P1.8.text: We provide you with a variety of temporary site access solutions tailor-made to meet your needs – for rental or purchase.

C:P1.9.text: We have the people, equipment, and know-how to deliver the solutions your project requires – no matter how complex.

C:P1.11.text: We’ll partner with you, visiting your site and crafting a comprehensive strategy that puts safety and cost-effectiveness at the top of the list.

C:P1.12.text: Success starts with thorough site prep. Count on us for every detail, minimizing risks and setting the stage for smooth, on-time, and on-budget operations.

C:P1.13.text: We’ll help keep your project on track by navigating the complexities of environmental and regulatory requirements, ensuring your site access is compliant.

C:P1.14.text: Our comprehensive restoration services bring ecological balance, preserve biodiversity, and support sustainable land management.

C:P1.15.text: Good for Your Business, Good for the Earth

C:P1.16.text: Keep your people safe in unpredictable conditions – thanks to our experienced teams and engineered DURA-BASE® matting.

C:P1.17.text: Our environmental planning services and site access solutions preserve the land – for both today and tomorrow.

C:P1.18.text: Keep projects running smoothly and safeguard your assets with our reliable service, fleet scale, and access management.

C:P1.19.text: “We continually strive to lead the industry with innovative solutions and next generation technologies that work in harmony with the environment and leave a positive impression on our communities.”

C:P1.21.text: Experience the game-changing benefits of DURA-BASE®, the leading heavy-duty composite matting solution for the toughest environments. As part of our full-service offering, DURA-BASE® provides the durable, reliable support you need for safe and efficient site access, no matter the project.
